title: Imperfect Is Perfect: Learned Column Prefilling for Branch-Price-and-Cut
abstract: arXiv:2610.21001v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Column generation folklore warns that initial columns hurt: a warm start may bias the dual and slow the root of branch-price-and-cut. We show the opposite once the columns are imperfect in the right way. Preloading the support of the optimal root LP, the best columns one could know in advance, fails to finish on half of our hardest instances; a pool of ordinary routes that need not belong to any optimal solution, held outside the master and priced at the current smoothed dual, speeds the root up. Because the columns need not be optimal, producing them becomes a learning task: a neural edge scorer guides a constructive generator that builds the pool in seconds. A second network predicts the initial center of Wentges smoothing from the instance file, and with it the direction of the smoothed pricing queries; the solver's own updates run unchanged. translated_title: 不完美即完美：面向分支定价切平面算法的学习式列预填充
translated_abstract: 列生成领域的经验之谈告诫说，初始列会带来危害：热启动可能使对偶变量产生偏差，从而拖慢分支定价切平面算法根节点的求解。我们证明，一旦这些列以恰当的方式保持“不完美”，情况恰恰相反。预加载最优根节点LP的支撑集——即人们所能预先知道的最好列——在我们最难的实例中有一半无法完成求解；而一组不必属于任何最优解的普通路径，存放于主问题之外并按当前平滑对偶进行定价，却能加速根节点的求解。由于这些列无需最优，生成它们便成为一个学习任务：一个神经边评分器引导构造式生成器，在几秒钟内构建该列池。第二个网络从实例文件预测Wentges平滑的初始中心，并由此确定平滑定价查询的方向；而求解器自身的更新过程保持不变。预填充与中心就位后，精确定价主导了根节点定价时间，因此我们重建bu（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了“恰当的不完美”这一反直觉发现——用神经网络在数秒内生成的不完美普通列（而非最优列）作为预填充，并预测Wentges平滑初始中心，反而能显著加速分支定价切平面算法的根节点求解。
en_tdlr: This paper shows the counterintuitive result that prefilling branch-price-and-cut with "imperfect in the right way" columns—ordinary routes generated in seconds by a neural edge scorer and a network-predicted Wentges smoothing center—speeds up root solving, whereas even preloading the optimal LP support fails on the hardest instances.
